# Security policy

## Supported versions

MxWave is pre-1.0 software. Security fixes are applied to the latest release and
the `main` branch; older snapshots are not maintained separately.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/kirillbilchenko/MxWave/security/advisories/new)
instead of opening a public issue. Include the affected version or commit,
reproduction steps, expected impact, and any suggested mitigation.

Do not include model access tokens, private checkpoint URLs, or other secrets in
the report. You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days.
